_comment: #508. The reference for the late-Victorian/Edwardian belt: painted wood siding and stucco,
domesticated 'painted lady' - cream, oatmeal, pale sage, pale blue-grey, ivory - with a bright
off-white sash trim, an ochre and a sage door leaf as the other two Accent1 draws. Accent2 is
the sill/lintel/hood/cornice-band/stoop-coping ramp: tan into a mid brown, so the secondary
trim reads as a shadow line rather than a second colour. Glass is the flat-lit glazing grey
the whole library shares; Metal is a neutral mid grey for sash hardware and railings.
Base has five draws because `pick` is the only per-building variation there is - one colour
here is 1002 identical buildings (the fault #508 was filed for).
Not verified in the Editor - no Unity was available to the author. These are authored values,
not eyeballed ones; retouch by eye is expected and welcome.
